paragraphs.text: Now press every consequence of the nature-alone view until it breaks. Desired by all spirits, yet bodies change by nature anyway. Occurrence without any union to explain it. Needlessness that fits neither spirit nor mind. No reunion allowed, yet rebirth happens. Liberation collapsed into mere nature. Compassion-acts that smuggle passion back in, turning the doctrine into passion-exhaustion.

Then drop that view as unjust and seal the proof instead: bodies famously have a sentient maker before them. Patterned difference is the flawless proof — this setup, nothing else. The reason stands aimed at the Supreme Lord, and no fault of logic shakes it, nor any rival’s. Only this is said, and the disputation closes.
